# Fluppy

> Fluppy is a Telegram Mini App and bot for running Telegram channels. It finds content from sources you choose, turns it into posts in your style, and prepares them for publishing — with approval mode or autopilot.

## What Fluppy is
- A Telegram Mini App + bot (works inside Telegram; no separate dashboard required)
- Helps channel owners, agencies, and solo creators keep a channel active
- Flow: collect from sources → style from settings → approve OR autopilot → publish
- Topics and sources are separate choices
- Approval and autopilot are equal modes — you choose how much control to keep

## What Fluppy is not
- Not a claim of self-learning or autonomous “AI that improves itself”
- Not a general-purpose social network outside Telegram
- Does not invent or claim third-party rankings, review scores, or tech-stack marketing
